title: Under the Ice, the Only Way Out Was Deeper

lines.text: They cut a hole in the ice and swam into a mountain.
The exit: two kilometres away, past a squeeze over 100 metres down.
Norway, February 2014. Five Finnish divers went in.
The cave is called Plura, in northern Norway.
The plan: swim right through, and climb out in another cave.
Near-freezing water. Two teams, two hours apart.
The first diver slipped through. Then he looked back.
His buddy's light was signalling. He was stuck, tangled in the passage.
His buddy never made it through.
In the deep section, a diver from team two also died.
The man behind him had no way forward.
So he turned around, and swam all the way back.
Hours of decompression later, all three survivors were in hospital.
The official recovery failed. Police banned diving in the cave.
Weeks later, the survivors went back anyway, to bring their friends home.

shots.description: COLD OPEN, frame 1 already moving. From under the water: a white ice ceiling, and a bright triangle of daylight being completed as a chainsaw bar (simple grey blade prop) cuts the last side; ice chips and bubbles fall. A gloved hand drops a white line through the triangle.
shots.camera: Low-angle 20 mm looking straight up at the triangle, slow push toward it; the triangle sits in upper-centre third.
shots.lighting: Cold daylight through the hole (area light, white-blue), everything else deep teal-black; caustics on the ice underside.

shots.description: 2.5D side section through a snowy mountain: left entrance (ice-covered pond, 'PLURA'), a route that dives in a deep U to a red-marked squeeze at the bottom, then climbs to a far exit cave ('STEINUGLEFLÅGET'). A cyan line draws itself along the route.
shots.camera: Starts tight on the left entrance, pans and pulls out to reveal the whole U as the line draws.
shots.lighting: Graphic; white snow outline, black rock, cyan water route, red squeeze marker.

overlay.text:
PLURA → STEINUGLEFLÅGET
~2 KM THROUGH THE MOUNTAIN

shots.description: Wide winter valley in grey polar light: bare trees, snow banks, a frozen pond at the foot of the mountain and a small dark triangle in its ice. Five small figures in drysuits with tanks stand around it; tank stacks on a sled.
shots.camera: Slow descending crane 28 mm from high above the valley toward the five figures.
characters: figure_diver x5 (faceless silhouettes, drysuits, twin tanks)
shots.lighting: Low overcast polar daylight; blue-grey; faint snow falling.

shots.description: Same valley, later: only three figures stand by the ice hole; two empty spaces in the snow where the others stood (two tank sets left upright on the sled). Snow keeps falling.
shots.camera: Locked-off match of S03's end framing; hard cut so the missing two read instantly.
shots.lighting: Dusk, darker blue; a single work lamp.

shots.description: Animated map: Scandinavia outline, zoom from Norway to Nordland/Rana, a pin drops on 'PLURA'. Arctic Circle drawn as a dashed line just north of the pin.
shots.lighting: Graphic; dark navy map, cyan pin.

shots.description: Back to the U section: five cyan dots appear at the Plura entrance, an arrow traces through the U and up to the dry exit chamber where a small rope ladder icon sits.
shots.camera: Diagram; slow left-to-right pan following the arrow.

shots.description: Inside Plura: a wide, clear blue-grey tunnel; two divers (team one) on scooters glide away along a white guideline; a timer overlay then fast-forwards and three more lights (team two) enter the same tunnel.
shots.camera: Wide 20 mm static at tunnel wall, divers pass left-to-right; time-jump via quick fade-through-white flash mid-shot.
shots.lighting: Clear water, torch beams; cold blue ambient.

shots.description: The tunnel narrows to a low, flattened slot between boulders; silt bed; two torch beams converge on it.
shots.camera: Slow push 28 mm toward the slot, framing the hole small in the centre.
shots.lighting: Torch beams only; darker; faint cyan.

shots.description: Diver_B squeezes through the slot (tanks scraping rock, silt puffs), emerges into a slightly bigger passage, then turns his whole body to look back at the slot.
shots.camera: Over-the-shoulder 35 mm on the far side of the slot; rack focus from diver_B to the slot behind him.
shots.lighting: His torch; behind the slot a second torch glows through silt.

shots.description: Through the slot: diver_A's torch blinks in a rapid pattern inside a cloud of silt; a thin cord loop is visible snagged around his gear at the edge of the slot. Only light and silhouette.
shots.camera: POV through the slot, 50 mm, handheld shake rising.
shots.lighting: Flickering torch (flicker builder, signal pattern), silt glow.

shots.description: The silt slowly settles; the blinking light behind the slot is now steady and still. Diver_B hangs motionless in his own beam.
shots.camera: Static wide 24 mm; long hold, slight slow pull-back.
shots.lighting: One steady distant light, one torch; very dark.

shots.description: MID-POINT TURN. Cross-section: one dot stopped at the squeeze (grey), one dot beyond it (cyan). Three new cyan dots enter from Plura and drop down the U toward the squeeze.
shots.camera: Locked diagram; slight push toward the squeeze marker.

shots.description: Deep section, darker and wider: three torch beams in silt; one of the three lights drifts away from the line and stops moving. Shown only as lights and silhouettes.
shots.camera: Wide 24 mm from a low rock shelf, slow crawl-in.
shots.lighting: Three torches, one going still; cold black-blue.

shots.description: A diver (team two, orange fins) faces the narrow slot; his torch shows the passage ahead is blocked (dark shape + equipment filling the opening, abstract). He hovers, stops.
shots.camera: Over-the-shoulder 35 mm, slot in centre, slow push stops short.

shots.description: Cross-section: the orange dot reverses and climbs back up the left side of the U all the way to the Plura entrance; a dotted trail shows the full distance retraced.
shots.camera: Diagram; follow the dot right-to-left with a slow pan.

shots.description: Decompression stop just under the ice: a lone diver hangs on the white line, the triangle of light above him now dim and blue; a timer counts hours fast. Cut-away final 0.8 s: ambulance-blue light flashing on snow.
shots.camera: Side-on 35 mm, very slow drift around the diver; then quick cut to the snow.
shots.lighting: Dim blue ice light from above; then flashing blue point light on snow.

shots.description: Document reveal over a snowy blur: a plain notice card 'DIVING PROHIBITED · PLURA' (generic, no logos) slaps onto the frame; behind it a simple barrier tape across the ice hole.
shots.camera: Card drops in with a small bounce; slow push.

overlay.text:
OFFICIAL RECOVERY FAILED
DIVING BANNED IN PLURA

shots.description: Return to the S01 composition from below the ice: the triangle of light; one after another, many torch beams drop through it into the dark (more lights than before). Final frame = S01 framing (loop point).
shots.camera: Low-angle 20 mm straight up, slow push into the light; hold last 0.6 s.
shots.lighting: Bright triangle of daylight, multiple torch beams, caustics.

loop_line: Weeks later, the survivors went back anyway, to bring their friends home.
